after_snippet:
import click

# In 8.4.0, Parameter.name is always str, empty string when expose_value=False
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
param = click.Option(['-t', '--test'], expose_value=False)
assert param.name == ''
before_snippet:
import click

# In 8.3.3, Parameter.name could be None when expose_value=False
ctx = click.Context(click.Command('test'))
param = click.Option(['-t', '--test'], expose_value=False)
assert param.name is None
title: Parameter.name is now str instead of str | None, and expose_value=False uses empty string instead of None
